description: Fix evidence-backed endpoint underuse across both agent platforms. Keep native command execution and ownership rules intact; make deterministic/indexed Hub calls the normal route when applicable and semantic calls explicitly conditional.

acceptance_criteria: Generated MCP schemas and agent instructions use one profile capability/action source and never advertise disabled actions.
High-profile defaults enable all intended profile-tier capabilities; lower profiles omit actions below their minimum tier.
Static and installed skill/prompt surfaces contain no stale fixed action lists that contradict the active schema.
Every enabled public MCP tool and action family has a concrete trigger and task intent; active-profile filters suppress unavailable actions.

local_ai_task is recommended by default for second-pass semantic review, uncertain reasoning, exploration, and evidence/log compression when matching actions, backend readiness, and quality gates are available.

Exact repository search, facts, tests, builds, and deterministic checks retain authoritative repo/native execution paths; semantic task work interprets evidence rather than duplicating these operations.
Runtime permission, quality, backend, and task-context checks remain authoritative; no guidance invents per-task grants.
Static review confirms Codex and Antigravity outputs align.
task_endpoint_routing.description: Generated routing now contains task-specific triggers for each profile-enabled MCP action family. local_ai_task semantic QA is a default second pass when review/reason/explore actions and quality gates are exposed. Exact lookup and deterministic/native validation retain authority.
task_endpoint_routing.next_action: Review generated prompt/schema output and focused tests; reconcile the current runtime's active task action set before claiming semantic QA is available.
task_endpoint_routing.title: Fix endpoint routing in Codex and Antigravity

title: Make applicable Local AI Hub endpoints default in Codex and Antigravity
